```yaml
name: Gitbook Docs Release
on:
  release:
    types: [published]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      tag:
        description: 'Tag to backfill (e.g., v3.3.9)'
        required: true

jobs:
  sync-gitbook:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Set TAG
        run: echo "TAG=${{ github.event_name == 'release' && github.ref_name || inputs.tag }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Parse tag
        run: |
          TAG=${{ env.TAG }}
          TAG=${TAG#v}
          MAJOR=$(echo $TAG | cut -d. -f1)
          MINOR=$(echo $TAG | cut -d. -f2)
          PATCH=$(echo $TAG | cut -d. -f3)
          echo "MAJOR=$MAJOR" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "MINOR=$MINOR" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "PATCH=$PATCH" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Set release name
        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'release' }}
        run: echo "RELEASE_NAME=${{ github.event.release.name }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Checkout tag
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          ref: ${{ env.TAG }}

      - name: Create docs branch
        run: |
          git checkout -b docs/v${{ env.MAJOR }}.${{ env.MINOR }}
          git push --force origin docs/v${{ env.MAJOR }}.${{ env.MINOR }}

      - name: Create Gitbook variant
        if: ${{ env.PATCH == '0' }}
        run: |
          curl -X POST "https://api.gitbook.com/v1/spaces/${{ secrets.GITBOOK_SPACE_ID }}/variants" \
            -H "Authorization: Bearer ${{ secrets.GITBOOK_TOKEN }}" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d "$(printf '{"name":"V%s.%s - %s","branch":"docs/v%s.%s"}' "${{ env.MAJOR }}" "${{ env.MINOR }}" "${{ env.RELEASE_NAME }}" "${{ env.MAJOR }}" "${{ env.MINOR }}")"
```
